title: Northgate Protect Complete Monthly Payment Grace Period
content:
When a Northgate Protect Complete Monthly fee is declined, the plan has a payment grace period in calendar days before it lapses, and claims are not accepted while the fee is unpaid within that grace period. The one-time tiers have no grace period.

| Tier | Calendar days after a declined monthly fee before the plan lapses | Claims accepted while a fee is unpaid within the grace period |
|---|---|---|
| Northgate Protect Standard 2-Year | Not applicable | No |
| Northgate Protect Standard 3-Year | Not applicable | No |
| Northgate Protect Accident 2-Year | Not applicable | No |
| Northgate Protect Accident 3-Year | Not applicable | No |
| Northgate Protect Accident 4-Year | Not applicable | No |
| Northgate Protect Complete Monthly | 15 | No |

- The 15-day grace period belongs to Northgate Protect Complete Monthly, the only tier paid monthly.
